desc: WiFi tracking item, superseding archived ticket 139. Firmware staging is DONE offline (evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-paired-wifi-firmware-builtin.md): corrected Image-macsmc-hid-type-fix-wifi-fw embeds the exact paired BCM4388 C0/C2 apple,mriya set while retaining the live keyboard fix, SMC, USB storage/UAS and usbnet. The remaining gate is PCIe link-up under ticket 124/175. Correction: op-115 is the read half of a plain RMW on a dead PHY-IP aperture, not a PLL-lock poll. CPU-physical shared-PHY addresses are 0x417004000/0x417008000 after the mandatory +0x200000000 /arm-io translation; never use raw ADT bus 0x217... values. Any live PCIe-PHY write is attended-only and separately reviewed.

progress: 2026-07-29: /private/tmp was purged at midnight, so the exact 25F84 corpus and extraction inputs were regenerated under persistent /Users/damsleth/Code/linux-build-out storage; all corpus hashes pass. scripts/t6040-kbuild.sh now supports fail-closed T6040_WIFI_FW_BUILTIN=1 with 12 exact pinned files, CONFIG_EXTRA_FIRMWARE, built-in brcmfmac/cfg80211/RFKILL, unique artifact naming, and post-link symbol checks. First firmware diagnostic Image-macsmc-wifi-fw 28f71703 was byte-reproducible and all 12 linked blobs matched source, but packaging review correctly demoted it because it omitted HID_TYPE_FIX and UAS. Corrected Image-macsmc-hid-type-fix-wifi-fw SHA256 eae54e62d8733a925b68f75d32a6bd7a1e38379574f94a70f8247f5cfcbe0165 was independently rebuilt byte-identically; xz 12d6f4712873db053105cc9ca00d80bb729a5b1987490a72817b7edb30f05338. It retains SMC, the live keyboard fix, USB storage/UAS, usbnet and the exact firmware. Strict-verified dual-mode graphical object b512b9fd52631ec4a8837a971601520d7af509e244e43fef9f30e84aa5a63420 preserves the 10-second door and proven rootfs; kernel and initramfs both pass m1n1's host XzDecode harness. No rig run; controlled 16 KiB-kernel smoke plus PCIe link-up still gate enrollment/WiFi. | 2026-07-29 ATTENDED — OP-115 SOLVED (evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-pcie-op115-SOLVED-links-dont-train.md). V1 (upstream PCIe wholesale, 28a4e0cf) chainloaded over KIS; PCIe triggered on demand via the proxy P_PCIE_INIT command (p.pcie_init(), no kernel payload). pcie_init COMPLETED for the first time on T6040: 'Initializing t6040 PCIe controller' / port 0 + port 1 max speed 2 / 'Initialized controller 0' / returned 0. CONFIRMED: the wrong PHY reset bit (BIT(7) vs BIT(4)) was the ENTIRE cause — our ticket-058 clkgen PLL sequence and delta D1 were NOT preconditions, so V2 (3916bf15) is UNNECESSARY, do not run it. Linux then booted with the PCIe DT (Image-pcie + t6040-j614s-dcuart-pcie.dtb) to a BusyBox shell: pcie-apple probes, ECAM at 0x1cb0000000 for bus 00-08, both root ports enumerate (0000:00:00.0 and 00:01.0, 106b:100c, PME+AER on IRQ 52/54). REMAINING BLOCKER = LINK TRAINING: 'pci@0,0 link didn't come up' + 'pci@1,0 link didn't come up', and DLL_LINK_ACTIVE=0 read independently from m1n1 over the proxy (LnkCap 0x00737812 max gen2 x1, LnkSta 0x1011 on both ports). No BCM4388, no SD reader. RULED OUT: PERST pins correct (ADT function-perst GPIO 0x4/0x5 == our reset-gpios 4/5); CLKREQ pinmux present and referenced (ADT function-clkreq GPIO(0,2)/(1,2) == our pcie-pins pinmux 0x20000/0x20001 via pinctrl-0); PINCTRL_APPLE_GPIO=y and 51c000000.pinctrl bound; DT reg layout correct (ECAM+rc+4 port core+4 port phy); no PCIe dmesg errors beyond the two link lines (pms_fpwm/HID errors are pre-existing and unrelated); double-init is NOT the cause of no-link (m1n1 alone on a virgin boot also shows DLL_LINK_ACTIVE=0). NOTE m1n1's Apple port checks (APCIE_PORT_STATUS_RUN/LINKSTS) pass silently and are NOT equivalent to DLL_LINK_ACTIVE — 'Initialized controller 0' does not mean link up. HAZARD FOUND: pcie_init must run ONCE PER POWER CYCLE. Running it from the proxy and then again from kboot caused a synchronous data abort (ESR 0x96000410, FAR 0x41705a000 = port 2 PHY-IP window +0x2000) and a reboot; the clean-boot retry worked. The pcie_initialized static guards only within one m1n1 instance, not across a chainload. NEXT (priority order): (1) endpoint POWER — ADT pci-bridge1 has function-sd_pwr_en = SMC key 'gP19' so the SD reader cannot train without an SMC key write (a NEW SMC write beyond smc_reboot/smc_rtc: needs decode + explicit approval); pci-bridge0 (WiFi) has NO pwren in the ADT so its rail comes from elsewhere — identify it. (2) ADT per-bridge timing t-refclk-to-perst=100 / perst-to-config=100 — check pcie-apple honours an equivalent delay on t602x. (3) 'no iommu-map translation for id 0x0/0x8' in dmesg. (4) diff yuka's t8140-pcie (a7857af8) port bring-up for anything M4-specific after LTSSM start. | 2026-07-29 *** WIFI AND BLUETOOTH WORKING *** (evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-WIFI-AND-BLUETOOTH-WORKING.md). wlan0 + phy0 exist with running firmware (BCM4388/6 wl0 version 23.50.20.0.41.51.208) and the module's own OTP MAC 84:2f:57:33:9e:d7 (our DT passes all-zero local-mac-address, so a real MAC proves the dongle is alive); ip link set wlan0 up succeeds. hci0 present with BT firmware loaded. GL9755 SD reader enumerated (17a0:9755) but unbound because MMC_SDHCI_PCI is still -m. THREE fixes were needed: (1) ROOT CAUSE endpoint power — WL_REG_ON and sd_pwr_en are SMC KEY WRITES (ADT /amfm function-reg_on=pKW4('gP13',0x800000), pcie-sdreader function-sd_pwr_en=pKW4('gP19',0x0)); gpio-macsmc maps a line to key gP%02x by hex so they are smc_gpio 19 and 25, matching upstream t603x-j514-j516.dtsi (M3 Pro MBP predecessor) exactly. Added smc_gpio child + pwren-gpios -> both links up in 4ms/8ms. (2) apple,antenna-sku was missing: brcmfmac's Apple NVRAM path needs board-type AND antenna-sku AND valid OTP, else it never tries board_types[2] '<board>-<otp.module>-<otp.vendor>' = apple,mriya-WLMT-u which is how our corpus is named. SKU = 'X3' from ADT wifi-antenna-sku-info 0x3358. (3) upstream maps BCM4388 rev>=4 to the c0 FILENAME but this rev-6 silicon wants the c2 BLOBS -> c2 content staged under the c0 -WLMT-u names, which is what finally made brcmf_pcie_download_fw_nvram succeed. PRESERVE THAT MAPPING when regenerating the corpus; worth an upstream question. Artifacts: m1n1 V1 28a4e0cf, Image-macsmc-hid-type-fix 3b904313 (16K pages, PCIE_APPLE/GPIO_MACSMC/BRCMFMAC/BT_HCIBCM4377 all =y), t6040-j614s-dcuart-wifi.dtb, initramfs-dcuart-pcie-fw3.cpio.gz. KBUILD TRAPS now asserted: PCIE_APPLE depends on PAGE_SIZE_16KB (16K must be selected FIRST or -e silently no-ops), and RFKILL must be =y or CFG80211/BRCMFMAC stay modular. REMAINING: association needs wpa_supplicant/iw (dwm image); hci0 needs bluetoothctl; SD needs MMC_SDHCI_PCI=y. NOTE: pwren-gpios means the kernel's gpio-macsmc performs two SMC key writes (gP13/gP19) - PMU GPIO outputs, what macOS and upstream Asahi do, but outside the literal smc_reboot/smc_rtc surface; flagged for CJ, revert by deleting the two pwren-gpios lines. | 2026-07-29 *** WIFI CONFIRMED END TO END *** (CJ, at the panel on the enrolled dual-mode object): wpa_supplicant associated, udhcpc obtained a DHCP lease from the local router, and ping -c3 1.1.1.1 returned 3/3 with 0% loss and RTT 3.656/6.504/11.934 ms. Full chain proven: PCIe link-up -> BCM4388 firmware -> WPA association -> DHCP -> routed internet. Benign warnings to ignore: 'Failed to create interface p2p-dev-wlan0: -52' / 'P2P: Failed to enable P2P Device interface' — brcmfmac does not implement the nl80211 P2P DEVICE interface on this chip; wpa_supplicant falls back to the normal station path and association/DHCP are unaffected. Silence with p2p_disabled=1 in the wpa_supplicant config. TICKET CLOSED.
